title: Azure Secure Landing Zone Baseline
description: IaC implementation of an Azure landing zone with security best practices: network segmentation, Azure Policy enforcement, RBAC, centralized Log Analytics, and compliance monitoring.

title: SIEM Detection Pack (Microsoft Sentinel)
description: KQL-based detection rules for Azure Sentinel targeting suspicious auth, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and data exfiltration — all mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

title: DevSecOps CI/CD Security Gates
description: Reference CI/CD pipeline with integrated SAST (SonarQube), dependency vulnerability checks, container scanning (Trivy), IaC security validation, and automated security testing gates.

title: Secure API Gateway Pattern
description: Production-ready API gateway with JWT auth, rate limiting, request validation, SQLi/XSS protection, and comprehensive logging. Full OWASP API Top 10 mitigations.

title: Threat Model: CRM Web Application
description: Full STRIDE threat model for a multi-tenant CRM: data flow diagrams, trust boundaries, threat identification, risk scoring, and prioritized mitigation guidance.
